[Thinking]
**Answering about Indian Prime Ministers**

The user asks in Italian about the longest-serving Indian Prime Minister. I know that Jawaharlal Nehru held office from August 15, 1947, to May 27, 1964, totaling about 16 years and 286 days. On the other hand, Narendra Modi has been in office since May 26, 2014, which amounts to roughly 11 years as of May 22, 2026. Therefore, the longest-serving PM is Nehru. I could mention that Indira Gandhi served for around 11 years non-consecutively.
[/Thinking]

Il primo ministro indiano rimasto in carica più a lungo è stato Jawaharlal Nehru. È stato in carica dal 15 agosto 1947 al 27 maggio 1964, per circa 16 anni e 286 giorni.
